decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation builds directly on the firm's in-house laser know-how and stayed on the website in both years, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it. Its lower prominence carries some risk that it gets folded into newer laser offerings.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core inkjet expertise and has kept its own page for two years, which points to a stable, well-understood line.
The piezo inkjet printer draws on the firm's established printhead and integration knowledge and is consistently presented on its own page, so the firm can absorb market feedback and improve it.
The industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page and extend the firm's core laser competence toward Industry 4.0 traceability, making them a strategic priority.
The compact laser cabin was freshly launched with its own page and builds on existing laser and enclosure know-how, so it is too early and too well grounded in the firm's knowledge to drop.

The lubricant printing system for sheet metal transfers the firm's high-resolution printing knowledge to a new application and won a Blechexpo award. Its niche market is offset by that validated value, which the firm's own R&D can build on.
